definitions.gloss: same family; same clan; same kind
definitions.explanation: Belonging to the same family, clan, or lineage; also, by extension, of the same kind or group. Most often met in business compounds describing companies owned and run by one family.

examples.japanese: {同族|どうぞく}{会社|がいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I got a job at a family-owned company.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{創業|そうぎょう}→創業：11792_sougyou⟧⟦{以来|いらい}→以来：01831_irai⟧{同族|どうぞく}⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: This company has been run by the founding family ever since it was established.

examples.japanese: {同族|どうぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めぐる⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{珍|めずら}しくない→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧。
examples.english: Even among members of the same family, disputes over inheritance are not unusual.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同族|どうぞく}{会社|がいしゃ}: family-owned company
- {同族|どうぞく}⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧: family management (of a business)
- {同族|どうぞく}⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧: sense of kinship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一族|いちぞく}→一族：11229_ichizoku⟧: a clan or extended family as a group of people; {同族|どうぞく} describes the relationship of belonging to the same one, and is usually the first half of a compound.
